{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative or neutral over recent days, especially if model overestimates.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude after sharp upward spikes in history, as mean reversion often follows.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent high sentiment values, especially when true outcomes are trending upward.",
    "Apply lag correction: if true outcome is higher than forecast 3-5 days ago, slightly increase current forecast.",
    "When sentiment shows strong bullish momentum (e.g., >0.5), model should not over-forecast; cap upward revisions at +10% of recent mean.",
    "For low sentiment or negative sentiment, apply downward bias correction: subtract 2-5% of recent 7-day average if forecast exceeds true outcome by >10%.",
    "If model consistently underestimates during high volatility periods, increase forecast by 3-5% to account for lagged market reaction."
  ]
}
